Base64 encode and decode tests with vectors, corrupt inputs, round trips, and throughput benchmarks.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_base64` encode and decode functions. It defines fixed test vectors from RFC 4648 and a set of invalid Base64 strings, then checks that `fd_base64_encode` and `fd_base64_decode` return the expected results. It also runs a large round-trip test with random data to verify that encoding and then decoding returns the original bytes. At the end, it performs a decode throughput benchmark and prints performance results before reporting `pass`.
